notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it, and Vorel of the Hull Clade has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}{U}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Vorel of the Hull Clade.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may target any other creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade's ability.
